question: In skeletal skeletal muscle of mammals:

options.opa: A motor neuron supplies all its fibers.
options.opb: Each motor neuron supplies a single fiber.
options.opc: Each fiber receives innervation from a single motor neuron.
options.opd: Summation of synaptic potentials is required to reach the excitation threshold.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Each motor neuron innervates multiple muscle fibers -> This is known as motor unit -> 95%
enhanced_information: In skeletal muscle of mammals, each motor neuron innervates multiple muscle fibers forming a motor unit. This is a known fact in muscle physiology. The interaction between motor neurons and muscle cells is part of the neuron-muscle motor unit relationship, supporting the concept of motor units in muscle innervation.
analysis: In skeletal muscle of mammals, each motor neuron innervates multiple muscle fibers forming a motor unit. This aligns with the known concept of motor units in muscle physiology. Therefore, each fiber receives innervation from a single motor neuron is the most likely correct option.
